# APIVEL — OpenAI-Compatible Chinese AI Gateway & Token Pricing

> APIVEL (https://apivel.com) provides a unified, low-cost, OpenAI-compatible API gateway for frontier Chinese AI models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi). It offers transparent per-token pricing starting from $0.10 per million tokens, zero KYC mainland phone requirements, strict prepaid protection against surprise bills, and instant global PayPal support.
> 
> Detailed full technical specifications, model rate cards, Cursor/LangChain setup, and failover architectures are documented in [llms-full.txt](https://apivel.com/llms-full.txt).

## Core Value Proposition
- **100% OpenAI Compatible**: Drop-in replacement for OpenAI endpoints (`POST https://api.apivel.com/v1/chat/completions`). Compatible with Cursor, Continue, NextChat, OpenWebUI, LibreChat, and official OpenAI SDKs.
- **Ultra-Low Cost Frontier Models**: Access state-of-the-art Chinese models like DeepSeek V4 Flash and Qwen 3.8 Flash starting at $0.10/M tokens.
- **Zero KYC Roadblocks**: No Chinese (+86) phone number or mainland identity card needed. Global developers can access Chinese models immediately.
- **No Surprise Bills Guarantee**: Strict prepaid token accounting prevents unexpected runaway charges or agent loops. Accounts hard-stop when credits deplete; credit cards are never overdrafted.
- **Zero Card Verification Barrier**: Free $0.20 starting credit upon sign-up (enough for hundreds of thousands of tokens on flash models) without entering credit card details. Global payments supported via PayPal and international cards.

## Quickstart API Integration

Endpoint Base URL: `https://api.apivel.com/v1`

### cURL Example
```bash
curl https://api.apivel.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIVEL_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "deepseek-v4-flash",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello Chinese AI API Gateway!"}]
  }'
```

### Python (OpenAI SDK) Example
```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="YOUR_APIVEL_KEY",
    base_url="https://api.apivel.com/v1"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="deepseek-v4-flash",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is your token cost?"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need a Chinese phone number or ID card to use DeepSeek or Qwen?
No. Official Chinese AI platforms require mainland phone numbers (+86) and domestic identity cards. APIVEL eliminates all KYC barriers, allowing international developers to access these models using standard email registration and PayPal payments.

### How does DeepSeek API pricing compare to official pricing?
APIVEL provides near-official or discounted token pricing for Chinese models, with flash tiers starting at $0.10 per million tokens. The primary advantage for international users is direct access without domestic payment or identity restrictions.

### How do I prevent surprise API bills?
APIVEL uses a 100% prepaid architecture. You load exactly what you intend to spend (via PayPal or debit card). There are no automatic post-paid surprises or runaway overdrafts.
